content.text: Lord judge between me and thee, Gen. 16:5 (1 Sam. 24:12). Who made thee … a judge over us, Ex. 2:14 (Acts 7:27). Moses sat to judge the people, Ex. 18:13. let them judge the people at all seasons, Ex. 18:22 (18:19–26). in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour, Lev. 19:15. I charged your judges … judge righteously, Deut. 1:16 (16:18). judges shall make diligent inquisition, Deut. 19:18. Lord raised up judges, which delivered them, Judg. 2:16. sin against another, the judge shall judge him, 1 Sam. 2:25. make us a king to judge us like all the nations, 1 Sam. 8:5. he cometh to judge the earth, 1 Chr. 16:33 (Ps. 96:13; 98:9). ye judge not for man, but for the Lord, 2 Chr. 19:6. God judgeth the righteous, Ps. 7:11. To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, Ps. 10:18. be clear when thou judgest, Ps. 51:4 (Rom. 3:4). do ye judge uprightly, Ps. 58:1. God is the judge, Ps. 75:7. God … judgeth among the gods, Ps. 82:1. He shall judge among the heathen, Ps. 110:6. judge the fatherless, plead for the widow, Isa. 1:17. they judge not the fatherless, Isa. 1:23. he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, Isa. 11:3. with righteousness shall he judge the poor, Isa. 11:4. Lord is our judge, Isa. 33:22. mine arms shall judge the people, Isa. 51:5. right of the needy do they not judge, Jer. 5:28. judge thee according to thy ways, Ezek. 7:3 (7:8; 36:19). saviours shall … judge the mount of Esau, Obad. 1:21.

adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, Matt. 5:25 (Luke 12:58). Judge not, that ye be not judged, Matt. 7:1 (Luke 6:37; 3 Ne. 14:1). they shall be your judges, Matt. 12:27 (Luke 11:19). Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, Luke 19:22. Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son, John 5:22. Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment, John 7:24. Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, John 7:51. Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man, John 8:15. I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, John 12:47. because the prince of this world is judged, John 16:11. thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me, Acts 23:3. wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself, Rom. 2:1. sinned in the law shall be judged by the law, Rom. 2:12. judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man, 1 Cor. 2:15. what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within, 1 Cor. 5:12. saints shall judge the world, 1 Cor. 6:2. Know ye not that we shall judge angels, 1 Cor. 6:3. would judge ourselves, we should not be judged, 1 Cor. 11:31. Let no man therefore judge you in meat, Col. 2:16. whoremongers and adulterers God will judge, Heb. 13:4. become judges of evil thoughts, James 2:4. they that shall be judged by the law of liberty, James 2:12. He that … judgeth his brother … judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, James 4:11. the judge standeth before the door, James 5:9. without respect of persons judgeth according to every man’s work, 1 Pet. 1:17. committed himself to him that judgeth righteously, 1 Pet. 2:23. judged according to men in the flesh, 1 Pet. 4:6. time of the dead, that they should be judged, Rev. 11:18. book of life: and the dead were judged, Rev. 20:12.

Son of … God was judged of the world, 1 Ne. 11:32. twelve apostles … shall judge the twelve tribes of Israel, 1 Ne. 12:9. stand before God, to be judged, 1 Ne. 15:33. words shall judge them at the last day, 2 Ne. 25:18. stand before the throne of God, and be judged, 2 Ne. 28:23. with righteousness shall the Lord God judge, 2 Ne. 30:9. if ye judge the man who putteth up his petition to you, Mosiah 4:22. whosoever transgresseth against me, him shall ye judge, Mosiah 26:29. appoint judges, to judge … wise men to be judges, that will judge, Mosiah 29:11 (29:28). better that a man should be judged of God than of man, Mosiah 29:12. rise from the dead and … be judged, Alma 11:41. men should be judged according to their works, Alma 41:3. they are their own judges, Alma 41:7. deal justly, judge righteously, Alma 41:14. stand before God, to be judged, 3 Ne. 26:4. out of the books … shall the world be judged, 3 Ne. 27:26. twelve tribes of Israel, who shall be judged … by the twelve whom Jesus chose, Morm. 3:18. this people … judged by the twelve whom Jesus chose in this land, Morm. 3:19. that judgeth rashly shall be judged rashly, Morm. 8:19. man shall not … judge; for judgment is mine, Morm. 8:20. it is given unto you to judge, Moro. 7:15. I show unto you the way to judge, Moro. 7:16 (7:14–18). same judgment which ye judge ye shall also be judged, Moro. 7:18. great Jehovah, the Eternal Judge, Moro. 10:34.

Spirit which leadeth … to judge righteously, D&C 11:12. by them shall the world be judged, D&C 20:13. to judge the whole house of Israel, D&C 29:12. appointed to be a judge in Israel, D&C 58:17. let God judge between me and thee, D&C 64:11. made my church … like unto a judge … to judge the nations, D&C 64:37 (64:38). be judged according to men in the flesh, D&C 88:99 (1 Pet. 4:6; D&C 138:34). Lord, will judge all men according to their works, D&C 137:9.
